foundation_laws: Unknown or unresolved critical passage authority may permit diagnosis but may not permit nonzero revision.
Canon, protected language, authorial intent, POV/knowledge, explicit user constraints, required ambiguity, semantic core and named-author targeting are hard pre-evaluation preservation boundaries.
Voice identity, character integrity, narrative distance, register and collateral-effect concerns remain review evidence and cannot become a self-issued pass.
Missing clean-control, project-holdout or required homogenization evidence fails closed rather than silently passing.
The original passage is the immutable recovery anchor for Prose candidate work; candidate generation never overwrites it.
Retry of an unchanged deterministic Prose computation must not broaden authority or change its semantic disposition.
A retry with materially changed input/evidence is a new evaluation attempt and must not reuse prior PASS as authority.
Technical timeout or crash before a qualified Prose result creates no Book canonical effect because Prose owns no Book canonical writer.
Candidate rollback is discard/retain-original, not inverse manuscript mutation.
Preference-learning rollback is append-only USER_REVOKE_EVENT history; prior evidence remains reconstructible.
No retry, rollback, timeout recovery or failure path may create author, Book canonical, publication, promotion, production, A-01 or native authority.
